stories.title: Top EU official calls for negotiations with Iran and an end to war
stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula Von der Leyen has called for negotiations with Iran and an end to hostilities.

stories.title: Where do reported US-Iran ‘negotiations’ leave Israel?
stories.summary: Israeli analysts report confusion following US President Trump's unexpected shift from threatening strikes on Iran to pursuing diplomatic talks.

stories.title: Colombian military plane crash kills at least 66
stories.summary: A Colombian military plane crash has killed at least 66 people; the defence minister described it as a tragic accident, though the cause remains unclear.

stories.title: Inside the alleged Russian operation to trigger anti-government protests in Angola
stories.summary: A group of Russians and Angolans are facing trial in Angola on charges of attempting to incite anti-government protests, which the defendants deny.

stories.title: UK universities flock to India - but will they succeed?
stories.summary: Nine UK universities are establishing campuses in India, though initial student enrolment is expected to be modest.

stories.title: Oil falls and shares rebound after Trump says talks have been held to end war
stories.summary: Oil prices fell and stock markets rebounded after US President Trump announced that productive talks had been held to end the war.

stories.title: A committed pharmacist and a homesick blogger – the Iranian civilians killed in the war
stories.summary: Civilian casualties in Iran continue to mount as the US-Israeli military campaign against the country continues.

stories.title: Ex-teacher accused of Scotland school abuse found guilty of sex attack in South Africa
stories.summary: A court in Cape Town, South Africa, found former Scottish teacher Iain Wares guilty of indecently assaulting a former student who accused him of sexual abuse dating back to the 1980s.

stories.title: US' and Iran's options for ending war narrow the longer it goes on
stories.summary: Iran has shown no signs of backing down in the conflict, while analysts note that US air power alone cannot achieve Washington's primary objectives.

stories.title: Israeli settlers target Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank, attacking people and properties
stories.summary: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villages and properties in the occupied West Bank following the death of 18-year-old settler Yehuda Sherman, who was reportedly struck by a Palestinian-driven vehicle.

stories.title: National blackout hits Cuba for second time in a week
stories.summary: Cuba experienced its second nationwide power grid failure in a week amid ongoing hardship linked to US fuel restrictions.

stories.title: Israel to expand ground and air attacks against Hezbollah in Lebanon
stories.summary: Israel has announced plans to expand ground and air operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon, raising fears of a large-scale ground invasion.

stories.title: Iranian missiles injure 180 in towns near Israeli nuclear site
stories.summary: Iranian ballistic missiles injured 180 people in towns near an Israeli nuclear facility, prompting Israel to investigate how the missiles penetrated its air defense systems.

stories.title: Car stolen with two-month-old baby inside
stories.summary: A baby boy was stolen along with a car but was rescued unharmed by police and reunited with his mother shortly afterward.

stories.title: Venezuelan leader replaces senior military commanders
stories.summary: Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro has replaced senior military commanders following the appointment of a new defence minister by Delcy Rodríguez.
